correctness.rationale: Von Staudt–Clausen supplies the necessary obstruction: if q-1|p-1, q divides the reduced denominator, so not the numerator. Conversely when none of the q divide denominators, every q dividing m=(p-1)/2 is >3 and Adams Bernoulli numerator theorem gives q^e|A_p for q^e||m, proving the iff. Since B_(p-1) denominator even and numerator odd, Svinin chi(p)=2 iff m|A_p. The represented primes >3 of -x^2+2xy+2y^2=3y^2-(x-y)^2 are exactly 11 mod12, via residues and the norm form for class-number-one Q(sqrt3). All primes p=551 mod660 violate the criterion by q=11; Dirichlet supplies infinitely many. For leastness, any q|(p-1)/2 with q-1|p-1 for p≡11 mod12 must be q≡11 mod12 and q(q-1)k=p-1 with k≡5 mod6, giving below1871 only 551 and1211, both composite; 1871 itself prime and represented by x=27,y=25. Independent integer factor search through p<20000 identified 1871 as first obstruction and verified congruence identities; finite enumeration is not proof of the infinite progression/classification.
